changelog:
crmkit v0.1.2

- Added detailed SKILL.md agent operating manual, covering authentication, capabilities, and usage conventions.
- Expanded documentation on endpoints, workspace/team management, plans/limits, and step-up authentication for sensitive actions.
- Clarified response formats (plain text and JSON) and provided instructions for filtering, sorting, and pagination with examples.
- Included guidance for MCP (Model Context Protocol) connector integrations with chat clients.
summary: An agent-first CRM, built for an AI agent to operate over a plain-text HTTP API. Headless by design (no UI). Responses are grepable plain text by default, or...
